verdict.rationale: Browser Use offers programmatic, code-driven automation "at scale" via its Python library and cloud API. Tasks like extracting structured data about all followers to CSV, or LinkedIn friend-request automation, imply operating across many items. However, no dedicated bulk or batch operation feature is documented; multi-item work is left to the agent's task loop or the user's own code orchestrating runs and sessions. Missing for 10: a documented batch/parallel-run API, explicit bulk-action primitives, concurrency or rate-limit guidance for many items, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workloads.
